resources.string: Import your workouts, steps, heart rate and distance recorded by your watch or another app. Read-only: nothing is ever written to Health Connect.
Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Health Connect needs to be installed or updated for the import to work.
Health Connect gave access to no data. You can ask again, or choose what you share in Health Connect.
No access granted: the import stays off.
The Sport module can read some Health Connect data, if you allow it. Here is exactly which, and what becomes of it.
Your workouts (type, start, duration, title), your steps day by day, and your heart rate and distance during those workouts. Nothing else: not your route, not your sleep, no other health data.

To fill the Sport module without typing everything again: the workouts your watch recorded, and your step calendar. Heart rate and distance are only used to complete each workout (average, maximum, kilometres).
Nowhere but your phone, in the app\'s encrypted vault. There is no account and no server, and the app does not even ask for Internet access. Reading only happens while the app is open and unlocked.
The app never writes to Health Connect and never deletes anything from it.
Turn off « Import from Health Connect » in Sport › Types and pedometer, or remove access from Health Connect. What was already imported stays in your vault until you delete it.
